front_content.text:
原句：提高基础研究投入强度，是提升国家原始创新能力的关键举措。

任务：先汉译英，再选出学术语体最稳的一项。

back_content.text: Increasing investment intensity in basic research is a key measure for enhancing a country's capacity for original innovation.
back_content.explanation: investment intensity in... 与 capacity for original innovation 是教育科技政策语体中的高频稳定搭配。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子核心是“举措—能力提升”逻辑，翻译需保留政策术语与因果方向，避免口语化泛译。

② 核心规律：表达“提高投入强度”时，increase investment intensity in... 比 increase the amount of money 更凝练；表达“提升能力”时，capacity for ... 是标准书面搭配。

③ 验证：A 术语准确、结构完整。B 中 strength of investment 生硬；C 把 original innovation 位置处理不当；D 缺少关键冠词与介词配合。
tips: 教育科技政策句可优先采用 measure, capacity, intensity 等名词化表达。
for enhancing... 常用于“举措对应目标”的正式表达。

options.text: Increasing investment intensity in basic research is a key measure for enhancing a country's capacity for original innovation.
Increasing the investment strength of basic research is the key measure to improve a country's original innovation ability.
To increase investment intensity in basic research is a key measure for a country's capacity of enhancing original innovation.
Increasing investment intensity in basic research is key measure for enhancing country capacity for original innovation.

front_content.text:
原句：高水平大学建设应当更加注重学科交叉与产学研协同。

先做汉译英，再补全表达：
The development of high-level universities should place greater emphasis {{blank}} interdisciplinary integration and industry-university-research collaboration.

back_content.text: The development of high-level universities should place greater emphasis on interdisciplinary integration and industry-university-research collaboration.
back_content.explanation: place emphasis on... 是固定搭配，用于“更加注重”。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“更加注重”在正式英文中高频对应 place greater emphasis on...，空格本质是搭配介词。

② 核心规律：emphasis 后固定接 on；若接 in/for/to 会造成非标准搭配。后面的 interdisciplinary integration 与 collaboration 是并列对象，直接由 on 统一引出。

③ 验证：填 on 后，句子结构为 place greater emphasis on A and B，语法与语义都完整，且符合教育政策语体。
tips: emphasis 的高频搭配是 place/put emphasis on。
学术政策句里并列名词对象常用 and 直接并列，避免重复介词。

front_content.text:
原句：高水平人才培养体系不断优化，为科技产业协同创新提供了持续动力。

任务：先汉译英，再核对是否完整表达“体系优化—协同创新动力”关系。

back_content.text: The continuous optimization of high-level talent cultivation systems has provided sustained momentum for coordinated innovation between science and industry.
back_content.explanation: 教育经济句中 momentum 可有效承接“持续动力”。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子体现制度优化与创新动力之间的因果关系。

② 核心规律：可用名词化主语承载“优化”，谓语承载“提供动力”结果。

③ 验证与纠偏：译文中 cause-result 链条清晰，核心信息完整。
tips: momentum 是政策语体中的高频结果词。
coordinated innovation 对应“协同创新”。

front_content.text:
原句：教育评价机制改革，不仅促进了教学质量提升，也推动了资源配置方式优化。

任务：先汉译英，再选出并列最自然的一项。

back_content.text: Reform of educational evaluation mechanisms not only promotes improvements in teaching quality but also drives optimization of resource-allocation methods.
back_content.explanation: not only ... but also ... 用于并列双结果表达最稳。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“不仅……也……”提示并列结果。

② 核心规律：并列句中两个谓语应保持时态与语义层级一致。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 并列与术语都更规范。
tips: 并列结构优先保持谓语平行。
evaluation mechanism reform 是常见政策术语。

options.text: Reform of educational evaluation mechanisms not only promotes improvements in teaching quality but also drives optimization of resource-allocation methods.
Reform of educational evaluation mechanisms not only promote improvements in teaching quality but also drives optimization of resource-allocation methods.
Reform of educational evaluation mechanisms not only promotes improvements in teaching quality but also driving optimization of resource-allocation methods.
Reform of educational evaluation mechanisms promotes not only improvements in teaching quality but also to drive optimization of resource-allocation methods.

front_content.text:
原句：产教融合平台建设持续推进，为学生提升实践能力创造了更真实的场景。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
The continued development of industry-education integration platforms has created more authentic contexts {{blank}} students to improve practical competence.

back_content.text: The continued development of industry-education integration platforms has created more authentic contexts for students to improve practical competence.
back_content.explanation: create contexts for sb to do sth 是稳定结构。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句尾是“为学生……创造场景”的目的导向结构。

② 核心规律：for sb to do sth 常用于表达“为某人提供条件以便做某事”。

③ 验证与纠偏：填 for 后结构完整，目的关系清晰。
tips: for sb to do 是目的导向高频结构。
practical competence 对应“实践能力”。

front_content.text:
原句：完善产学研协同机制，是提升区域创新体系韧性的关键路径。

任务：先汉译英，再选出结构和术语都最规范的一项。

back_content.text: Improving industry-university-research collaboration mechanisms is a key pathway to enhancing the resilience of regional innovation systems.
back_content.explanation: key pathway to doing sth 对应“提升……的关键路径”。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：句子核心为“机制完善—韧性提升”逻辑。

② 核心规律：政策术语句优先保证机制名词、目标名词和路径结构准确。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 在术语完整度和句式自然度上最佳。
tips: pathway to doing 是“实现路径”的高频表达。
resilience of innovation systems 是“创新体系韧性”的稳妥译法。

options.text: Improving industry-university-research collaboration mechanisms is a key pathway to enhancing the resilience of regional innovation systems.
Improving industry-university-research collaboration mechanisms is key pathway to enhancing the resilience of regional innovation systems.
Improving industry-university-research collaboration mechanisms are a key pathway to enhancing the resilience of regional innovation systems.
